value.rule: Require equal immutable document/source, exact rooted locator, canonical decimal array index with no leading zero, nonnegative ordinal, and locator = parent locator || literal family suffix || ordinal::text. UQ(document_id,locator) then implies one record per slot. Validate count, min=0, max=count-1 and no extra/missing slot; source_records.ordinal is the direct SQL order. Do not infer missing rows as empty outside an accepted complete contract. Heatmap actor locators are exact /team or /player children of the declared map source record; neither source-record ID ordering nor global actor joins select an observation.

value.rule: Native observed profile references must have exact actor/source ownership, source_record at the declared actor object locator, profile_context = native_match_observation_v1:<source_record_id>, variant source:exact, and valid recorded interval at the pinned catalogue generation. Physical FK + exact record identifies at most one profile. Global contexts are forbidden. Native external ID state controls source_record.external_key; NULL is not guessed absent. Coverage root source_record.external_key retains data.match_id under its explicit state. Allowed source actor kinds are the bounded event player/sub-in, lineup member, root detail home/away team and heatmap row team/player paths. Each actor occurrence uses its own exact source_record; no coarse shared root. For players external_profile_version_id = native-observation:<actor source_record_id> avoids the separate existing natural uniqueness collision. A same-record identical profile is reused; a contradictory same-record value is rejected. A map rendering variant is not a profile variant.

value.rule: A bound native lineup uses the complete coverage FK; each member has lineup_revision_id and an exact /starters/<ordinal> or /subs/<ordinal> source locator under that side header, resolved same-source actor and exact observed profile. One slot per lineup/source_record at every historical generation (not just current unique index). All source value/state changes replace the accepted parent observation; no member edit under the same immutable source observation. Validate list states/counts, no foreign side/player/variant and no global-profile fallback. When raw position/shirt is populated in both the observed member and its exact profile, require value/type-state equality with IS NOT DISTINCT FROM semantics.

No dedup, reverse-key guess, title/format inference or numeric coercion. Unknown/unregistered meanings block acceptance. Unresolved prior matches retain native IDs/fields without a fabricated public link.

value.rule: Native IDs in qualified contracts are strings. Native identity property state is an explicit enum; never infer absence from a missing metadata row. For value require one exact same-document/source field/object record with external_key NOT NULL, including empty string; for null/absent require NULL external key/no invented alias. Value references use the exact locator under the accepted parent/child. Raw root data.match_id is coverage source record external_key; actor ID is observed profile source record external_key; event team_id and H2H home/away id use exact /team_id or /home/id,/away/id identity field records. Other ID types remain an explicit unaccepted source extension, not a coercion.
